_about: Polished · the art review's re-light: warm key, weaker chromatic cool fill (shadow sides ~half value, violet not grey), soft shadows, chunky clouds, sun glow, light height haze, contact shadows; emissive-only bloom for when you switch it to night.
_tweak: light.fill / light.env (how dark the shadow sides go), light.shadowRadius, clouds.coverage.
_stack: grade runs before bloom on purpose: on the night build bloom otherwise smears a non-finite scene pixel into a black blob (grade's clamp scrubs it). Keep grade on and first while bloom is on.
